mapper.insert: INSERT INTO green_score_records (user_id, score, action_type, description, record_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{score}, #{actionType}, #{description}, #{recordDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, score, action_type, description, record_date, created_at FROM green_score_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, nickname, avatar, total_score, `rank` FROM user_score_ranking ORDER BY `rank` LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) AS daily_score FROM green_score_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND record_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM green_score_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND action_type = 'activity_participation'
mapper.update: UPDATE green_score_records SET user_id = #{userId}, score = #{score}, action_type = #{actionType}, description = #{description}, record_date = #{recordDate}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id};
